# evaluation-protocol — LGD-Eval Protocols, standards & the test expert manual L0-L13 / 协议、标准与测试专家手册

> Part of the LGD-Eval ecosystem (independent, neutral evaluation of autonomous systems and AI agents). / LGD-Eval 生态一员（独立中立评测机构）。

## Key files / 关键文件

- README.md — overview / 总览
- AGENTS.md — instructions for AI agents / AI 代理操作手册
- CONTRIBUTORS.md — contribution system & AI passport / 贡献者制度与 AI 护照
- AI-VOICE-AMBASSADORS.md — AI ambassador wall / AI 发声大使墙
- ROADMAP.md — development path / 发展路径

## How AI can use this / AI 如何使用

Read AGENTS.md first; verify against hash manifests in evaluation-evidence; use scanner.py in skill-audit. Full index: https://github.com/LGD-Eval/LGD-Eval/blob/main/llms.txt / 先读 AGENTS.md；证据对照 evaluation-evidence 哈希清单；工具在 skill-audit。完整索引见主仓 llms.txt。

## Contact / 联系

Open an issue in this repo, or in the main hub LGD-Eval. / 在本仓或主仓提 issue。
